gloss: to slip into; to get mixed in; to blend into

definitions.gloss: to slip into; to sneak in; to get mixed in
definitions.explanation: To enter or become part of a group or place unnoticed, either intentionally or accidentally. Describes someone or something blending in with surroundings or a crowd without being detected.

definitions.gloss: to get mixed in among; to become lost among
definitions.explanation: For an object or item to become indistinguishable among others, making it difficult to find or separate.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{紛|まぎ}れる→紛れる：07572_magireru⟧ (to become indistinguishable, to blend) and ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (directional suffix indicating going inward). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the nuance of entering or penetrating into something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人混|ひとご}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}む: to slip into a crowd
- ⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}む: to blend into a throng
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}む: to get mixed in with documents
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紛|まぎ}れ{込|こ}む: to get mixed in with luggage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忍|しの}び{込|こ}む→忍び込む：12578_shinobikomu⟧: to sneak in — emphasizes stealth and deliberate intent, often for a criminal purpose
- ⟦{入|はい}り{込|こ}む→入り込む：04629_hairikomu⟧: to enter, go into — neutral; simply describes going inside without the nuance of blending in
- ⟦{混|ま}じる→混じる：02421_majiru⟧: to be mixed — describes the state of being blended rather than the action of slipping in
